items.scope:
Root Scope: Organizations that are cooperative partners of CERT@VDE.
CNA Scope: Products of CERT@VDE cooperative partners and brands listed at https://cert.vde.com/en/cna/. Also, industrial and infrastructure control systems (and its components) of European Union (EU) based vendors unless covered by the scope of another CNA. Partners and brands include but are not limited to: ADS-TEC Industrial IT, Auma, sipos, Beckhoff, Bender, Bucher Automation, CLAAS, 365FarmNet, Satinfo, Carlo Gavazzi Controls, Codesys, DURAG GROUP, Draeger, Endress+Hauser, Euchner, Festo Didactic, Festo, Frauscher, GEA, HIMA, Harman, Helmholz, Hilscher, K4 DIGITAL, KEB, Krohne, Kuka, Lenze, BHN Services, MB connect line, Miele, Murrelektronik, PHOENIX CONTACT, Etherwan Systems, Innominate, Pepperl+Fuchs, Pilz, SMA, SWARCO, Trumpf, TRUMPF Laser, TRUMPF Werkzeugmaschinen, VARTA Storage, VEGA, WAGO, M&M Software, Weidmueller, Welotec, Wiesemann & Theis, ifm.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All CrowdStrike products.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Ericsson issues only.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Zscaler issues only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Zephyr project components, and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
ASR products only.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
Crafter CMS issues only.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
All Ribose products and services, including open source projects, supported products, and end-of-life/end-of-service products.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
TIBCO issues only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
NVIDIA issues only.
All Honeywell products.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Third-party products it researches.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Pegasystems products only.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
All Gallagher security products only.
Palantir products and technologies only.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
OPPO devices only.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.

Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Juniper issues only.
All Centreon product issues only.
